{{Quote|It was Imperial Transport who brought you there, Imperial Supply who arranged and provisioned that house for you, and Imperial Engineering who built the camouflaged island landing site for your use.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Imperial Supply Corps''',<ref name="FaDCR" /> also known as '''Logistics and Supply''',<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> the '''Imperial Supply Fleet''',<ref name="EGTW /> or simply '''Imperial Supply''',<ref name="TLC" /> was a subdivision of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that dealt with the transportation of supplies. [[Abhean Shipyards]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing company based over [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]], built and maintained container vessels for the Imperial Supply Corps.<ref name="FaDCR" />

It was most likely a branch of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], as graduates of the [[Imperial Merchant Galactic Academy]] were required to meet an obligation to the Imperial Supply Fleet before they could fully join the [[Merchant Galactic/Legends|Merchant Galactic]], a civilian auxiliary of the navy.<ref name="EGTW" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], they set up a house, under orders from [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], for the [[Joruus C'baoth|clone]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]].<ref name="TLC" />
